summary.text: Caleb Theodros is a Democratic member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 41 since January 2025 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
His career experience includes working as a banker and a community organizer.

paragraphs.text: Caleb Theodros graduated from Cato Middle College High School and earned a bachelor's degree in economics and political science from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a banker and a community organizer.

Theodros assumed office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Natasha Marcus, and for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as Appropriations on Department of Transportation, Education/Higher Education, and Transportation.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he named economic development, education and mental health as his three key campaign messages.
